title: The Reacher - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: The Reacher in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A tall reach of terrain holding Lithum and Tireso, and Alicia's fight via Maelle's relationship questline.

sections.title: How to Reach The Reacher
sections.content: Reached in Act 3. Alicia's encounter additionally requires Maelle's relationship level to be high enough.
